An '''island chain''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sanctuary]] was settled by the planet's original colonists. The islands' residents fished the Sanctuary's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and [[Farmer/Legends|farmed]] the islands themselves.<ref name="Strongholds" />
